name: Our Dollhouse
source:
You wake up in a strange, windowless room, unaware of how you got there. You soon discover that you were kidnapped by a mysterious person, and you’re not alone.

A young man has been trapped here with you, and seems just as confused as you are. You work together to find a way out, but the more time passes, the less inclined to escape your companion seems to become… Soon enough, he begins to suggest you should both stay here—together, forever, in the dollhouse.

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/our-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一间陌生、没有窗户的房间里醒来，完全不知道自己是怎么来到这里的。很快，你发现自己遭到了某个神秘人的绑架，而且被绑来的不止你一个。

一名年轻男子和你一起被困在这里，看上去也和你一样困惑。你们合力寻找出路，可时间越久，你的同伴似乎就越不愿逃走……没过多久，他便开始提议，让你们都留在这里——永远在一起，住在这座玩偶屋里。

[摘自[url=https://florisam.itch.io/our-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
